_comment: Silkscreen part number -> Betaflight driver part key (see the 'drivers'
section of firmware.json). Only needed where the marking on the schematic
differs from the name Betaflight gave the driver. Everything that matches a
driver key directly needs no entry here.
Keys are matched case-insensitively after stripping -, _ and whitespace, so
'SPA06-003', 'spa06_003' and 'SPA06003' all hit the same entry.
This is the one hand-maintained file in the pipeline; firmware.json is
generated. Add an entry when a vendor's schematic uses a marking the
_flash_comment: The m25p16 driver's JEDEC table covers the whole W25Q family with no
per-capacity gate, so USE_FLASH_W25Q128FV is the correct define for a
W25Q64/256/512 as well. Mapping them here keeps that fact in one place.
